f3_params._about: Income-related parameters of main_formulation_3 (everything else is read from the EV-Solomon files). Placeholder values for the experiments: the formulation only needs the directions (mu non-increasing, every value of time non-decreasing, W non-increasing in income). Each sensitivity is a straight line from its value at theta = 0 (lowest income) to its value at theta = 1 (highest income).

theta_distribution._about: theta_i ~ Beta(a, b), drawn independently per EV. a = b = 1 is uniform on [0, 1]; a = b = 2 is bell-shaped (most customers in the middle). The same EV number gets the same theta in every file of a Solomon class (seed = seed_base + class + file size).

money_sensitivity_mu._about: Perceived cost per rupee paid (Rs/Rs). Must satisfy theta0 >= theta1 > 0.

value_of_time_Rs_per_min._about: D = driving to an FCS, Q = queueing at an FCS, C = charging at an FCS (driver present), V = car parked while it waits for and is charged by a van (driver free). Each must satisfy theta1 >= theta0 >= 0; Q > D and V <= C at both ends, and V may not rise faster than C.

queue_tolerance_W_min._about: Longest queue a customer accepts at an FCS (minutes). Must satisfy theta0 >= theta1 >= 0.

tariff_Rs_per_kWh._about: What the customer pays per kWh at an FCS (p_F) and for the van service (p_M), with p_M >= p_F.
